visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera focuses on a young girl with dark hair and bangs wearing a cream-colored t-shirt with a passion fruit pattern and light blue denim shorts. She is in a bright indoor room with light wood floors. She points to her right knee with a concerned expression while standing and squatting slightly. (2) A close-up of the girl's face shows her looking down at her knee, her eyebrows furrowed. An adult's hand briefly enters the frame to stroke her leg. In the background, other children are seated on the floor near a toy area. (3) The girl turns and runs towards the back of the room where a toy kitchen and storage shelves are located. She picks up a red toy medical bag and walks back toward the camera with a determined look. (4) The girl crouches on the floor, opens the red bag, and pulls out a toy stethoscope. She places it around her neck and begins to press the chest piece against her own knee and then against the adult's foot, which is resting on the floor. (5) An adult's hands help the girl remove a strip of blue circular toy stickers from the bag. The girl takes one and carefully applies it to her knee. She then picks up a toy bread item and holds it out towards the adult's face. (6) The video ends with a full-screen pink graphic showing a cartoon illustration of the same girl and text branding.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A young child's high-pitched voice claims her knee hurts, accompanied by a bright, mid-tempo acoustic pop BGM featuring guitar and piano. The adult female voice responds with high-arousal encouragement. (2) The acoustic scene is punctuated by the soft, rhythmic thud of a child running across a wooden floor. The child's vocal distance increases and then decreases as she returns with a toy. (3) Sharp, high-frequency plastic rustling and impact sounds occur as the toy bag is opened. The child's vocal pitch drops slightly as she assumes a more serious, focused role, followed by a soft metallic-like 'ding' from the toy set. (4) Continuous dialogue between the child and adult occurs over the steady BGM. The sounds of toy pieces being moved create short-duration broadband bursts. (5) A final vocalization of satisfaction 'Hao chi' from the adult is heard as the BGM rises in volume, concluding with a melodic synth chime.
